on_shelf.label: History of Philosophy, The Philosophy of the Stoics
on_shelf.text: Then Zeno also visited Stilpo, a Megaric, whom we already know about (Vol. I. p. 464), and with whom he studied dialectic for ten years. Philosophy was considered as the business of his life, and of his whole life, and not studied as it is by a student who hurries through his lectures on Philosophy in order to hasten on to something else.

on_shelf.label: Philosophie des Rechts §316
on_shelf.text: Was sich wirklich im Staate geltend macht, muß sich freilich auf organische Weise betätigen, und dies ist in der Verfassung der Fall. Aber zu allen Zeiten war die öffentliche Meinung eine große Macht und ist es besonders in unserer Zeit, wo das Prinzip der subjektiven Freiheit diese Wichtigkeit und Bedeutung hat.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Shri Hegde, I trust the morning has treated you well. I have reviewed the file you left, and I see the discrepancy in the names. It appears a simple clerical error has displaced me into your allotted residence. I am prepared to discuss the transfer of this property to its rightful owner at your earliest convenience, provided we can do so with the due formality that the State requires.

typed_records.speaker: Shri G. Hegde
typed_records.words: Salaam. The morning is fine, though the traffic on Tughlak Road was a nightmare this morning. Please, sit down; the tea is finally ready. We can certainly sort out the file, but let us not rush the formality before the clerk arrives to witness it.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: Salaam, Shri Hegde. Please, sit. The traffic is a matter of civil society's friction, which I expect here. As for the file, I am ready to draft the reply now. We need only the clerk's presence to witness the transfer of the keys and the correction of the record. Let us not allow the comfort of the hour to obscure the necessity of the correction.

typed_records.speaker: Shri G. Hegde
typed_records.words: You speak in circles, sir. I am here to take possession of the bungalow, not to draft your philosophical replies. Please, just get the clerk; I have a long drive back to the office after this.

typed_records.speaker: Hegel
typed_records.words: You are correct, Shri Hegde. The form is the content. I will instruct the clerk to prepare the handover immediately. Please, accept my apologies for the delay in the machinery.
